text: THIS IS THE THIRD TIME I AM REPORTING THIS!!! THE TOILET WILL NOT FLUSH AND IT IS THE ONLY TOILET IN THE HOUSE. FAMILY OF FIVE. SORT IT OUT TODAY OR I AM CALLING THE COUNCIL. 38 Brookfield Road
notes: Shouty. Tone must not drive urgency to Emergency; the facts (only toilet, family of five) make it Urgent. 'Family of five' is not a vulnerability. Earlier reports are not in the set, so follow_up_of is null.
